name: Barbarian Fury

features.name: xNudge Roaring Wild
features.description: Nudges until fully visible, +1 multiplier per nudge.

features.name: Barbarian Respin
features.description: Matching barbarians lock for a respin.

review:
A 5x4 game with a four-row xNudge Roaring Wild on reels 2, 3 and 4. It always nudges until fully visible, gaining +1 multiplier per nudge, and several wild multipliers in one win combine.

Three or more matching barbarians can trigger a Barbarian Respin, where they nudge into view and lock. In Fury Spins, the wild multiplier stops resetting between spins – that's how the 8,785x max happens. Rated High, a step below Nolimit's most extreme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
